name: Your Eyes
source:
Murder on Vessel Pion!

At the end of a 40-year journey through space—a dinner party.

The crew of the Vessel Pion gathers to toast the culmination of their lifelong mission, their camaraderie, and their new world on the planet Azulea. Love blooms. Wine pours. The first body drops.

[From [url=https://burlapjoe.itch.io/your-eyes]Itch.io[/url]]
